units: metres, Y-up (x east, y up, z = -north): the frame of art/layout.json; the journey runs toward +x, the Mooring is at the origin

clouds_block.note: a starting point for the scene's `clouds` block (ADR-2100); colours are palette keys, to be driven by the palette moods (values shown are Ultraviolet Dream)

designed_for.note: tested in AV Gen with the scene's other values as they are (art test stills, work/art/it5/av); see notes/00-coordination.md, 'Art: iteration 5'

veil.note: the Veil's rooms are built as absences (masses.veil holds the walls). The engine's generated passage lobes (build.py veil_passage) would fill them: drop them, and take the Veil's glows from here (same names as the routes use).
veil.tags: lobes of masses.veil carry "tag": "wall" (a room's shell) or "plug" (the solid before the crash); if lobes may be denser than 1 (ADR-2105), the plug is where to use it
veil.wells: condensery_column leaves a well 60 m across under each stack (plan offsets in the works' frame (-58, 14), (-2, 30), (52, 2), turned by the Condensery's yaw): a glow in each lights the heads round it from below

plug.note: iteration 6: one layer of 60 m lobes (tag plug), built to stay shut under ADR-2106's erosion at 1.0 / 60 m. Authored 328 to 448 m from the 47.0 s point (54.25 to 56.95 s); out at about 56.85 s with 0.3 of the erosion on tag plug (the engine's LOBE_ERODE), 56.5 s with all of it. Lobes under about 50 m open in the erosion's bays: do not thin it, and keep the Condensery's light held at a tenth until 56.03 s. veil_pocket5 and veil_amber stand inside it.

veil.sill: masses.reveal_fore: a floor under the journey from the mouth (56.88 s) to a lip at 58.95 s and a spur on its right; at the lip the ocean break opens below and the far field on the right. Keep the air clear of anything else from 56.88 s.

glows.name: veil_rose
glows.note: the antechamber: the rose light seen in the gate's mouth from the garden

glows.name: veil_amber
glows.note: inside the plug, on the journey, 414 m from the 47.0 s point (56.15 s): the second and larger warm pulse; the mouth and the first of the sill are amber at the crash (56.88 s)

glows.name: veil_pocket4
glows.note: the lantern room: the last room before the plug

glows.name: veil_pocket5
glows.note: inside the plug, on the journey, 372 m from the 47.0 s point (55.2 s): the first amber, a pulse as the lens passes it

veil.note_it12: it12b: the middle of the Veil (x 250-494) is gone and its east part moved -244 m west (blender/nd_band.py VEIL_CUT); rooms, plug and sill metres above are it11's

ocean_plane.note: iteration 6: where the cosmic ocean's surface has to be for the reveal to see it (the lens looks 9 to 20 degrees down at the break). At y = -900 with a radius of 900 the reveal sees only the break's dark far wall. Tested in AV Gen at -130 and -110 (art artifacts, iteration 6). An ellipse a little larger than the break, not a wider disc: at a radius of 1,400 m its rim showed through the troughs of the sea 800 m away.

break.note: placed by design beside the Condensery, under the reveal; ADR-2101 sea.breaks takes it as it is (clouds_block.sea.breaks)

vortex.lip: two rings of torn lobes over the cut edge
vortex.audio: the pad's phrases: the throat's light swells (900 ms in, 2.4 s out); the rotation never changes speed
vortex.note: it12 (msg 149, owner-requested; overrides the no-vortex rule for this one place). The shelves are also given as lobes (masses.vortex, tag 'vortex', each with 'orbit': {centre, dps}) so the shape stands without the renderer; spin them about centre at dps (seek-safe: angle = dps * t). The rim shelf overhangs the break's cut edge (msg 149's 59.6 s 'too CG' edge).

wind.note: leans, shelves, the plume and `drift` share it

far_design.note: iteration 6: far_masses is a composed cloudscape in five named groups (all of them belong in clouds.farLobes): far_banks (ranges kilometres long), far_swells (low bands on the horizon at 5 to 9 km), far_tower (one tower with an anvil 9 km out, on the right of the reveal), far_cumulus, highwater (the cloud island of Highwater Mooring).
far_design.moon_sector: from the reveal the plan headings 10 to 33 degrees hold nothing taller than 1.5 degrees over the horizon: cloud there would hide the moon
far_design.needs: the march must still be sampling at 9 km with hazeDistance near 9000: if the tower and the swells do not show, raise `steps` or `maxDistance` before changing the lobes

highwater.note: a third settlement, never reached (layout zone `highwater`); glow `highwater` is its light in its cloud
